statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while Sunday closure leaves live NQ price-path evidence unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening is the principal conditional WATCH window.
headline: Low Tail with extreme weekend Stress; reopening remains the key conditional window
body: NQ is closed. Friday's hawkish rates repricing, unresolved Hormuz restrictions and yen-stability concerns keep reopening uncertainty elevated. Fresh Sunday headlines do not establish a new live Nasdaq discontinuity, and shared Finviz context is stale beyond 90 minutes.

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 11:00 UTC through Aug. 30 10:00 UTC, Tail remained 19% in normal mode. Stress rose from 75% to 80% as weekend reopening risk accumulated; confidence stayed in the mid-90s.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low while NQ is closed, then Stress rebuilds into the 22:00 UTC reopen. The first three reopening hours are conditional WATCH; meaningful retracement and two-sided price discovery would support de-escalation.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed. Friday's hawkish rates repricing and unresolved Hormuz and yen risks keep Stress extreme, while no live one-way path, failed retracement or session-extreme holding can be observed.

forecast.analysis: If no new shock develops, closed-market uncertainty should ease modestly. Tail stays low because the reopening gap, pullback depth and directional efficiency remain unobserved.

If geopolitical rhetoric remains contained, risk should stay headline-led rather than path-led. A future directional gap would still need shallow pullbacks or repeated extension to raise Tail materially.

drivers: Gap quality matters more than gap size

forecast.analysis: If Sunday newsflow stays stable, Stress should continue easing from its weekend peak. Tail remains low until real price discovery can test persistence and retracement depth.
A quiet late-Sunday baseline would keep Tail subdued. Fresh policy-cooperation concerns may affect sentiment, but they do not establish a Nasdaq mean-reversion failure before trading resumes.

forecast.analysis: Energy and geopolitical headlines can still alter reopening expectations. Without live NQ structure, any such shift affects Stress more than Tail until persistence is observable.

forecast.analysis: As the reopening approaches, latent gap risk begins to matter more. Tail remains low unless a future gap is followed by shallow retracements, failed pullbacks or repeated extension.
Two hours before Globex, Stress rebuilds as weekend information nears price discovery. Tail stays below WATCH because no directional path has printed yet.
One hour before Globex, uncertainty is concentrated around the opening auction. The key future checkpoints are gap persistence, first-retracement depth and cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: In the second reopening hour, WATCH remains appropriate if the initial move persists. Failure to hold extremes or a two-sided retracement would reduce Tail despite elevated Stress.

forecast.analysis: The third reopening hour remains a conditional WATCH slot. Continued one-way extension after failed pullbacks would sustain Tail; orderly retracement and cross-asset stabilization would favor de-escalation.
If the reopening move has started to retrace and volatility is becoming two-sided, Tail should fall within WATCH. Persistent extreme-holding would be the condition that prevents this de-escalation.
If price discovery is orderly by this stage, Tail returns to low while Stress can remain extreme. Renewed extension after a failed retracement would invalidate the de-escalation.
Assuming meaningful retracement has occurred, Tail should remain low into the Asian session. Cross-asset alignment would matter mainly if NQ again becomes directionally efficient.
If the market holds a two-sided overnight structure, Stress should continue easing. A fresh geopolitical shock or renewed one-way extension would be the main upside risk to these scores.
A stable overnight path would keep Tail low as European participation approaches. The relevant test is whether any prior directional move broadens or instead continues to retrace.
If European markets open without reinforcing a one-way Nasdaq move, Tail remains low. Broader confirmation would matter only if it coincides with renewed NQ persistence.
Early European trade is a secondary checkpoint. Conflicting cross-asset signals would favor mixed or normal structure rather than a Tail escalation.
As U.S. participants begin to return, Stress can rise modestly even with low Tail. A renewed aligned move in yields, semiconductors and NQ would be the main escalation condition.
Closer to U.S. premarket liquidity, Tail remains low unless overnight direction becomes persistent and retracements fail. Scheduled Monday data are later than this hour.
By this hour the market is closer to Monday U.S. catalysts, so Stress returns to extreme. Tail stays low absent observed no-retracement continuation or a fresh discontinuity.
